observed_source_facts: synthesize() receives bounded source chunks and emits a model-generated candidate packet.
review_candidate() presents reviewers with QUESTION, APPROACH and CANDIDATE JSON, but not the underlying source chunk text.

review_candidate() gates acceptance on reviewer medians for intrinsic consistency, GRF compatibility, project fit and novelty plus hard-contradiction and panel predicates; no source-support or source-entailment predicate is required.
compress_and_commit() stores an accepted candidate in knowledge_packets and emits knowledge_accepted semantics.
after acceptance, compress_and_commit() sets chunk_text=NULL for the bound accepted source ids, retaining source metadata/hash but not the exact bounded evidence text used during synthesis.

therefore the current review panel cannot directly discriminate a source-faithful synthesis from a plausible but source-unsupported synthesis before the packet is promoted into the distillery knowledge dataset.
